request:
Goal: Complete GitHub Issue #375 as one Spec-Driven Development flow: migrate the existing workflow feature from the core senti repository to the external workflow plugin repository, then remove the core-owned workflow implementation and workflow-specific integration text.

Scope: Treat this as a migration, not a redesign. Move existing senti workflow command behavior, board operations, workflow skill, flow prepare/finalize integration, ideas/follow-up extraction, GitHub Projects operations, AI-backed publishing/classification/composition, and related tests into the workflow plugin. Update core only where needed to support generic plugin command/hook/config/agent contracts and to remove workflow-specific code, config, tests, bundled copies, bootstrap special-cases, and prompt/skill hardcoding. Keep the senti workflow command as the plugin-provided top-level command.

Out of Scope: Do not add backward compatibility for deleted workflow subcommands. Do not add core workflow-specific public APIs. Do not redesign gh CLI or GraphQL access. Do not auto-migrate top-level workflow config. Do not remove historical artifacts or external-convention paths that only contain the word workflow outside the active runtime/source/test/config/package surface.

Verification: Core no longer owns workflow behavior or workflow-specific integration text. The plugin repo owns the migrated behavior and can be installed/enabled for this repo. Existing workflow behavior is preserved unless Issue #375 explicitly says otherwise.
